Shows a live panel in the top-left corner of the player with what audio sync has heard and why it is or isn\'t synced yet.
Sync subtitles to audio
Aligns subtitles with the dialogue when Auto Sync can\'t find a reliable match.
English speech model (%1$d MB)
Optional. Recognizes English speech and matches it with external English subtitles, for faster and more accurate sync. Uses more CPU and memory.

Download

Audio sampling
Listens to dialogue ahead of playback, so the sync is found sooner.
Off
Low
High
Listens only to what is playing, so syncing takes longer. Doesn\'t work with the mpv player.
Reads a few short dialogue samples ahead of playback over one connection, up to 75 MB per title. When metered sampling is enabled, this limit also applies on metered networks when set to High.
Fastest sync. Listens ahead to more scenes over several connections, usually up to 150 MB per title, and uses more CPU. Some servers limit how many connections they allow.
Audio subtitle sync

Speech detection uses Silero VAD v5 weights (MIT, Silero Team). Optional speech recognition uses sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0, k2-fsa) and its Zipformer GigaSpeech English model (Apache-2.0). Full notices ship with the app in licenses/audio_sync_NOTICE.md.
Sample across the film on metered networks
Allow extra dialogue samples on metered connections. Uses the Low sampling limit even when Audio sampling is set to High.
